topic: Clubbing of Income: Gift to Spouse
author: Rahul kp
caption:
⏱ 🟦 CA Inter · 8-second MCQ challenge

On 1 April 2025, Anil gave his wife Rita ₹10,00,000 as a gift, without consideration. She put it in a bank FD at 8% p.a. and received ₹80,000 interest for FY 2025-26. She also earned ₹3,00,000 salary and ₹50,000 interest on her own savings. Amount clubbed in Anil's income for A.Y. 2026-27?
